description.en: A whole living Aspidorhynchus acutirostris reconstruction without associated prey or a fossil slab. Body width, fin spread, missing margins and colour are inferred; the chosen scale is representative, not a measurement of the anchor specimen.
description.zh: Aspidorhynchus acutirostris的完整活体复原，不含伴生猎物或岩板。体宽、鳍展开、缺失边缘和颜色为推断；选定尺度是代表估值，并非主锚标本实测。

morphology: Long slender fish body with clearly pointed upper rostrum extending substantially beyond shorter lower jaw. Keep short lower-tip visible in lateral and perspective even with neutral almost closed mouth.

Head posterior to rostrum retains visible eye and opercular volume; rostrum is integrated premaxillary extension, not a detached horn or sawblade. Small teeth optional at low-poly scale, never fake huge shark jaws.

Single small dorsal and anal fins opposite each other far back near caudal peduncle, supported by museum account; not centered tall shark dorsal. Paired pectoral fins behind head and paired pelvic fins ventrally reconstructed conservatively.
Forked caudal fin vertically oriented, not horizontal whale fluke; slender peduncle. Broad lateral ganoid scale rows may be suggested with restrained facets rather than separate armor plates.
Neutral straight or very gently curved swimming posture. Restore living body thickness from flattened fossil, retain slender depth. No death entanglement, slab, pterosaur or extra animal.
Neutral muted grey/olive dorsal and light ventral color is artistic. Do not rely on color, name, scale or pose for distinctness.

scale.published_basis: Lopez-Arbarello and Schroeder 2013/2014 diagnosis: species up to c.80cm SL, neotype c.40cm SL. Neither value measures WDC CSG255.
scale.standard_length_definition: Premaxillary tip to caudal-fin base; total to longest caudal ray.
scale.target_limits: All component dimensions are approximate modeling targets, not specimen measurements. Upper extension/head length0.32 uses published species diagnosis30–36%; use whole head length including rostrum. Do not interpret as 32% total animal length.

scientific_limits.en: The photographs show laterally flattened articulated fossils, not living tissue. Body thickness, fin spread, missing or obscured fin margins, paired-side symmetry, eye contour and color are inferred. WDC CSG255 has no usable absolute scale in the retained Figure1; nominal 0.80m standard length is a representative species-scale choice, NOT a measurement of WDC CSG255. Published species maximum standard length is approximately0.80m; neotype standard length approximately0.40m. Standard length excludes caudal fin, so estimated modeled total length0.90m is a separate inference. Do not copy the trapped pterosaur or curved taphonomic posture. No unsupported genus-wide behavioral claim.
scientific_limits.zh: 照片为侧扁保存化石，不是活体软组织。体宽、鳍展开及遮挡/缺失鳍缘、对侧对称、眼球与颜色推定。WDC CSG255所留图1无可用绝对尺；0.80米标准长是同种代表尺度选值，不是该标本实测。文献种最大标准长约0.80米，新模标准长约0.40米。标准长不含尾鳍，模型约0.90米全长另外推定。不得复制被缠翼龙或埋藏弯曲姿态。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Aspidorhynchus acutirostris, anchored to WDC CSG255 with same-species neotype BSPG2012 I1 comparison. Only the fish is modeled, without prey, pterosaur, slab or fossil pose. Original genus-level target does not mandate another species or specimen.

acceptance: Front lateral: upper rostrum extends beyond lower tip about0.30–0.36headlength; full fish silhouette and separate lower tip remain readable.
Top: narrow integrated rostrum with fuller head/body behind, bilateral fin roots and tapering peduncle.
Side head-on: inferred modest body thickness, not flattened slab; no rostral horn disconnected from head.
Perspective: whole animal fits and unequal jaws remain visible at useful image scale. A small mouth gap is allowed for legibility, not extreme gape.
shape_gate.original_required_combination: Shape criterion: projecting pointed upper rostrum above a shorter lower jaw. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.

original_requirements_audit.selected_species_verified: WDC CSG255 listed under A.acutirostris in 2013 revision; BSPG2012 I1 is neotype.

shape_gate.visible_comparison: Retained WDC Fig1B and museum neotype image show projecting upper tip and shorter lower tip. Compare candidate directly in lateral view against these actual references; equal-jawed needlefish silhouette fails. This is not a claim of a supplied second 3D model.

specimen_lock.comparison: BSPG2012 I1, same-species neotype, not substitution
specimen_lock.original_lock: Original required selecting a species/specimen; no preassigned species, specimen or named three-way comparison.
